questions.question: Which specimen or diagnostic finding belongs in a reference record for Taenia solium?
options: Malaria rings inside erythrocytes in a thin blood film.
Microfilariae in a peripheral blood film.
Eggs or proglottids in stool for taeniasis; tissue disease requires a different diagnostic workup.
Asymmetrical pinworm eggs on a perianal adhesive-tape specimen.
questions.explanation: Eggs or proglottids in stool for taeniasis; tissue disease requires a different diagnostic workup. Stool microscopy at 100–400× detects Taenia-type eggs.
